dchub.description: DC Hub remote MCP server (Streamable HTTP): the orchestration layer for data center and energy intelligence. Call execute_plan first with the question as asked; it chains the right tools for power, grid, interconnection-queue, fiber, site and market questions and returns one dated, cited answer. Includes the Data Center Power Index (DCPI). Works without a key; DCHUB_API_KEY is optional (sent as the X-API-Key header). Docs: https://dchub.cloud/connect
